name: 93312 · Bakersfield, CA
findings: ZIP 93312 (Bakersfield) has 111 nonprofit organizations. 36 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 93312 (Bakersfield) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 93312 (Bakersfield) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 39% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 64 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
